gloss: the whole sky, sky full of

definitions.gloss: the whole sky, the entire sky, a sky full of
definitions.explanation: The entire expanse of the sky, used almost exclusively in the expression {満天|まんてん}の{星|ほし} (a sky full of stars). Describes a sky that is completely filled with something, most typically stars.

examples.japanese: {満天|まんてん}の{星|ほし}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The sky full of stars is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{上|うえ}で{満天|まんてん}の{星空|ほしぞら}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw a sky full of stars from the mountaintop.

examples.japanese: {都会|とかい}では{見|み}られない{満天|まんてん}の{星|ほし}に{感動|かんどう}した。
examples.english: I was moved by the sky full of stars, something you can't see in the city.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the fixed expression {満天|まんてん}の{星|ほし} (a sky full of stars) or {満天|まんてん}の{星空|ほしぞら} (a starry sky filled with stars). Rarely used outside this pattern.

Not to be confused with the homophone {満点|まんてん} (perfect score).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満天|まんてん}の{星|ほし}: a sky full of stars
- {満天|まんてん}の{星空|ほしぞら}: a starry sky (filled with stars)
- {満天|まんてん}の{星|ほし}の{下|もと}で: under a sky full of stars
